parsed.why: No trans-specific border, facility or policing exposure; facility access follows self-identified gender; hate-crime aggravation applied in practice; official and industry framing welcoming. Deductions: one region's repeal (resident-facing), conservative rural attitudes, dated conflicting violence data.

State-imposed universal exposure: visa/entry refusal and fraud-ineligibility screening aimed at trans travellers, birth-sex facility bans across many states (some criminal, one arrest, male-ward detention), custody care denial. Courts partially mitigate; no trans criminalisation.

No remedy anywhere: police, army and eastern militias commit violence or torture against LGBTQ people with near-total impunity, public-morals prosecution possible, expression censored, collapsed authority in places, no recognition or anti-discrimination protection.

Unenforced but live 'acts against nature' article used as a police bribe lever against perceived-gay people, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, hostile majority attitudes. Offset partly: reported violence is prosecuted; no documented arrests under the article.

No criminalisation and a tolerant reputation, but documented routine healthcare discrimination against trans women, ID-mismatch friction, unresolved birth-sex prison placement, surveillance, and 2025 Pride cancellations; recognition and protections unimplemented. No border data.
